title: BRAZILIAN AESTHETICS — Upper Body Specialization
author: Manuel
desc:
BAZILIAN AESTHETIC
Build the frame. Own the look.

Wider shoulders. A denser back. Arms that stand out.

BAZILIAN AESTHETIC is an 8-week, 5-day hypertrophy program built around upper-body specialization and balanced full-body development. The focus: a commanding V-taper, rounded delts, upper-back thickness, and developed arms.

Three upper-body days. Two lower-body days. Every session has a purpose.

Expect challenging volume, progressive overload, and clear effort targets—with recovery guiding your adjustments. Track your reps, build your strength, and earn your progress week by week.

Designed for gyms like Planet Fitness and Crunch, using machines, Smith, cables, and dumbbells.

• 8 weeks of structured training
• 5 sessions per week
• Upper-back, shoulder, and arm specialization
• Approximately 55–80 minutes of lifting
• 35 additional minutes of cardio per training day
• Recovery-based adjustments and an optional deload

Bring the effort. Follow the progression. Build your aesthetic.
